name: Heaven-Sent Rabbitry
description: An independent pumpkin patch in WA 98947, WA, Heaven-Sent Rabbitry grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples. The patch is busiest in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
